# Markdown Lens

> Markdown Lens is a free, privacy-first local Markdown editor and document-to-Markdown workbench with a multi-document workspace and GitHub-style preview.

- [Markdown Lens](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/): Product overview, Markdown editor, document conversion, privacy details, and links to converters.
- [PDF to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/pdf-to-markdown): Convert selectable text from PDF files into editable Markdown locally, with page markers, inferred headings and lists, and explicit limitations.
- [Word to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/word-to-markdown): Convert modern Word .docx files into Markdown locally while retaining headings, lists, links, simple tables, images, and common formatting.
- [PowerPoint to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/pptx-to-markdown): Convert PPTX slides, notes, tables, and embedded images locally.
- [Excel to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/excel-to-markdown): Convert visible XLSX worksheets into GitHub-flavored Markdown tables.
- [HTML to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/html-to-markdown): Convert local HTML files into editable Markdown.
- [CSV to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/csv-to-markdown): Convert CSV or TSV files into Markdown tables.
- [JSON to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/json-to-markdown): Pretty-print JSON locally as fenced Markdown.
- [XML to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/xml-to-markdown): Validate and pretty-print XML locally as fenced Markdown.
- [EPUB to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/epub-to-markdown): Convert unprotected EPUB chapters into one Markdown document.
- [Image to Markdown](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/image-to-markdown): Import images with optional local English OCR.
- [ZIP to Markdown Importer](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/zip-to-markdown): Convert supported files inside a local ZIP archive.
- [Supported Formats](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/supported-formats): Compare PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, ZIP, image OCR, and Markdown workflows and limitations.
- [Open the Markdown Editor](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/editor): Paste, edit, import, preview, copy, download, export, and print Markdown in a web browser.
- [Markdown Cheatsheet](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/markdown-cheatsheet): Examples of headings, lists, task lists, tables, code blocks, Mermaid diagrams, and math.
- [Full Product Reference](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed capabilities, privacy behavior, supported syntax, and common questions.
- [Open-source Repository](https://github.com/ayushhagarwal/markdown-lens): Source code, issues, license, and contribution information.

## Key facts

- Free and open source.
- No account required.
- Markdown, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, CSV/TSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, ZIP, and image documents are processed in the browser.
- Multi-document autosave and local assets use IndexedDB.
- Document content is not uploaded to a Markdown Lens backend.
- Text-based PDF and Word .docx files up to 100 MB can be converted to editable Markdown.
- Optional English image OCR runs locally. Scanned PDFs still need a dedicated OCR workflow, and legacy DOC/PPT/XLS files must be exported to modern formats.
- Supports GitHub-flavored Markdown, Mermaid, KaTeX math, and syntax-highlighted code.
